prompt: Create one polished LiteracyPath nonfiction book page in the same crisp black-outlined flat 2D children's educational style as the supplied reference, with smooth solid colors and simple cel shadows. No grain, text, labels, outer border or logos. Keep every essential wing, airplane and arrow within the central 76 percent of the canvas (12 percent margins). Use exactly the same white passenger plane with teal tail, left-facing profile, one visible near wing and near engine, far components hidden by side-view overlap. Plane is level in the middle of blue sky above open farmland, slightly smaller than reference to allow arrows. Show just ONE straight green diagram arrow pointing UP, rising from the near wing area at the fuselage center. Arrow is a scientific force mark, not a physical support. No downward arrow, no wing inset, no flapping. Leave generous sky above arrow tip.

visualReview.note: Same plane in level left-facing flight, one green upward lift arrow originates near wing; no support or duplicated force; safe margins.
visualReview.limits: Individual installed illustration inspection; independent sequence, reader, cards and narration reviewed separately.
